description: This file defines the 'HiringManagerAPI' class, which is an API endpoint for listing available employees for hiring managers within a recruitment module. It includes methods for retrieving employee data and applies various filters and pagination. The code integrates with the OrangeHRM system and utilizes traits for services and role management.
